Ritual — The Seam
(handwriting unstable)

They buried it wrong on purpose. The crypt was never a tomb. It is a seal, and the seal has a lock, and the lock has a key, and we were the key.

Nine of us stood where the lantern burns. We read what should not be read.

It did not break. It was already broken. We only showed it where the light comes in.

The dead below are not dead. They are holding the seam shut with their hands.

Do not take the lantern from this place. Do not count the graves. If the count is wrong, the seal opens from the inside.

One of us is already gone below. One of us was always below.
